subject: NetSuite + Chargebee renewal: procurement plan & PO timeline
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Kim <alex.kim@oracle.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: NetSuite renewal – current seat counts, timeline, and scope

Alex / NetSuite team,

We’re kicking off the procurement for the upcoming renewal window for NetSuite (annual subscription) and want to align on timing so Finance can issue a PO and Legal can complete a quick SLA review. High level: we’re evaluating the standard renewal quote vs. a 12-month committed pricing for the same seat footprint.

Quick asks to get me an internal checklist:
- Confirm the current subscription seat counts and add-on SKUs (Advanced Billing, OneWorld) you have on file for Redwood Inference.
- Share any renewal promotions or discount windows that expire in the next 30 days.
- Provide an updated quote and preferred PO email for processing.

We’re aiming to get a PO issued by the week of Mar 1 so accounting can close the Q1 run rate. Can you also indicate whether the quote can be updated to 12-month committed pricing and include any applicable payment terms (Net 30 vs Net 45)?

I’ve looped in Neha (Finance ops) and Connor (Legal) for the PO and SLA review. If it helps, we can schedule a 20-min sync later this week.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment stub: NetSuite_service_inventory.csv (text/csv)]

From: Alex Kim <alex.kim@oracle.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: NetSuite Renewals <netsuite-renewals@oracle.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: NetSuite renewal – current seat counts, timeline, and scope

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the heads up. We’ve pulled your account record and attached the preliminary renewal quote that reflects your current modules and seat counts. Quick notes:
- Current effective users: 82 seats (Finance + Revenue Ops + Integrations).
- Add-ons on file: Advanced Billing, Multi-Subsidiary OneWorld (3 subs).
- We can offer a 7% commit discount for a 12-month prepay or a 4% discount for a 12-month invoice schedule (Net 30).
- Quote validity: 30 days from 2026-02-18.

I attached the quote (NetSuite_Quote_2026-02-18.pdf). If you can confirm target PO date and the billing contact, I’ll route the final customer invoice instructions.

Alex Kim
NetSuite Account Executive
Oracle NetSuite
[Attachment: NetSuite_Quote_2026-02-18.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 11:24:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: NetSuite renewal – plan & owner tasks (internal)

Internal only — Marissa here with next steps after Alex’s quote. Summary: NetSuite can do a 7% prepay discount or 4% on Net 30 invoiced. Quote expires 2026-03-20. Recommended path: accept 4% Net 30 this year (cashflow neutral) unless Legal flags a material SLA/payment risk; pursue prepay only if product pricing for next year changes.

Action items:
- Neha: prepare PO template and confirm whether we need to route to Procurement or if Finance can issue directly. Target: PO ready by 2026-02-28.
- Connor: run SLA check on payment terms & data residency clause. Can you prioritize before 2026-03-03?
- Aditya: confirm whether any infra/integration work (billing connector) will change under the renewed contract and if there’s expected downtime for upgrade windows.

Also flagged: Chargebee renewal for our billing gateway occurs on a different cadence (mid-April); I’m cc’ing Sarah from FinanceOps (external consultant) to help coordinate if we want to consolidate timelines.

Marissa
Head of Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Internal: NetSuite renewal – plan & owner tasks (internal)

Marissa — attaching redlines and a short legal note. Key points from my review:
1) Payment terms: prefer Net 30 but ask for an explicit late-fee cap and a 30-day cure period for non-payment before service interruption.
2) Data processing: the standard DPA is mostly fine; request a clearer incident notification SLA (48 hours).
3) Termination for convenience: negotiate a 60-day notice window with scoped wind-down assistance for export of financial records.

I’ve redlined the SLA and included comments in the attached document. If we accept the 4% Net 30, I recommend we add the 30-day cure clause and the incident-notification language before signing.

Connor Obrien
Senior Counsel, Legal
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redlined_SLA_Netsuite.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Alex Kim <alex.kim@oracle.com>, Chargebee Account Team <billing@chargebee.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NetSuite + Chargebee renewal: procurement plan & PO timeline

Team — final update and PO attached.

Status: Legal redlines accepted with minor edits (Connor: implemented cure period + incident SLA). We accepted the 4% renewal discount on Net 30. Alex — please confirm you can reflect the agreed minor SLA edits and re-issue a final invoice/contract.

Procurement: PO #PO-2026-0457 issued and attached for NetSuite annual subscription. Please route invoice to finance@redwood.com and reference PO-2026-0457 on the invoice.

Chargebee: we’ve CC’d billing@chargebee.com to start the billing gateway renewal conversation. Chargebee rep, please send over renewal pricing and any consolidation options if we want to align cycles next year.

Links & attachments:
- PO: PO_PO-2026-0457.pdf (attached)
- DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/embeddedSigning?token=abc123-ds
- Internal procurement plan: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c-netsuite-procurement-plan

Neha Kapoor
Finance Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: PO_PO-2026-0457.pdf (application/pdf)]
